confidence_notes: Crowdsourced data support meals, cappuccino and draft beer. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Pisa) Cocktail and wine estimates use their prices relative to draft beer on a small sample of local menus. [Route 66](https://route66musicpub.it/it/food-menu/drink-list/), [Alligalli](https://www.ristorantealligalli.it/menu/) July lodging is modeled, with private hostel rooms the most uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lucca and other mid-sized Tuscan destinations provide a lodging benchmark for July sightseeing demand. Pisa’s university and rail connections also inform the budget estimates.
